'''2010 Canadian Nationals Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Profit
* '''Username:''' Blarg
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
